subject: Update arguments for ft.create and ft.search json (#369) (#504)
reason: The change edits only the command-documentation metadata files src/commands/ft.aggregate.json, ft.create.json and ft.search.json, which document the existing argument grammar for the valkey.io command reference. These JSON files are not consumed anywhere: src/commands/CMakeLists.txt compiles only the .cc/.h parser sources, no build step embeds or generates code from the JSON, and the module registers its commands in src/module_loader.cc via vmsdk::CreateCommand without calling ValkeyModule_SetCommandInfo, so COMMAND DOCS/INFO output and all FT.CREATE/FT.SEARCH/FT.AGGREGATE parsing and replies
